svg.desc: A splice diagram shows inclusion or skipping of exon 6b. The normalised crossing ratio averages 1.00 in wild type, 0.52 after Nova1/2 loss and 0.84 after editing both ROBO loci in that background. At E10.5, the mean lumbar commissure ratio rises from 0.21 in wild type to 0.40 with Robo1 exon deletion. Animal and measurement counts are tabulated separately.

g.text: 6b encodes a linker between Ig3 and Ig4.
The included ROBO1 form produces a
stronger repulsive response in the assay.
